paragraphs.text: Traxos is a construct ( dragon engine ) from Dominaria . Designed by Mishra , it was instrumental in the Fall of Kroog .

The ancient city of Kroog was destroyed by the artificer Mishra and his war machines during the Antiquities War in the year 28 AR . Foremost among these machines was Traxos, an engine of destruction based on Phyrexian designs. Recently, excavation teams from Tolaria at Lat-Nam found and inadvertently reactivated the ancient war machine, which prowls old battlefields in search of Urza 's forces.

When Elesh Norn 's Phyrexians invaded Dominaria , they were met with an unpleasant surprise in the remains of Kroog. Though it was based on Phyrexian designs, Traxos had no allegiance to the invaders, deeming them an enemy that must be exterminated as well.

In the Echoverse , Traxos is a dragon construct and protector of Tolaria . The mighty war machine Traxos fell dormant after the First Brothers' War. Centuries later, Tolaria's first angel scholar, Lyra , raised it from its inertia, believing that this legendary tool of war could become a protector. Lyra rebuilt the engine as a mighty defender of Tolaria, improving on Mishra's original designs, which were inspired by his dreams of an unblemished world of nine nested spheres. She refined the machine into a work of art, a towering sentinel that would protect Tolaria from the inevitable threats of the future. Today, Traxos stands ready with a new purpose.
